The receptionist at this GP practice was shockingly rude and unprofessional. She was sarcastic, dismissive, and constantly talked over me, then accused me of interrupting when I was simply trying to speak. At one point she snapped, “I shouldn’t have to keep repeating myself, but as you’re not listening,” which was completely inappropriate and unnecessarily aggressive.

There was absolutely no politeness, no patience, and no basic human decency. She was hostile from the start and made a simple interaction feel confrontational and stressful. This is not how patients should ever be spoken to, especially in a healthcare setting.

After reading other Google reviews, it’s clear this isn’t an isolated incident. Multiple people have experienced the same rude, dismissive behaviour, which suggests this is an ongoing problem that the practice is either ignoring or allowing. Completely unacceptable. Patients deserve to be treated with basic courtesy and respect, especially in a healthcare setting.
